findings.evidence: Grep hits: `RegularityConditions.lean:65` defines `Complex.arg (limUnder (𝓝[>] t₀) (deriv γ)) - Complex.arg (-limUnder (𝓝[<] t₀) (deriv γ))`; Mathlib has `arg_one = 0` and `arg_neg_one = π` at `Complex/Arg.lean:201,208`; HW arXiv:1808.00997 lines 211-213 and 350 define α as the positively oriented angle in `[0,2π]`, and roadmap README lines 179-181 requires the smooth on-curve half-residue case.
findings.fix: Define the positively oriented angle from `L₊` to `-L₋`, normalized into `[0, 2π]` (or use `Real.Angle` and take the canonical nonnegative representative), then state rationality against that value.
findings.issue: `crossingAngle` subtracts principal arguments as `arg L₊ - arg (-L₋)`, giving the negative of HW's positively oriented angle and leaving it unnormalized; for the smooth curve `γ t = t` at `0`, this is `arg 1 - arg (-1) = -π`, while the HW/roadmap half-residue case needs angle `π`.

summary: The crossing-angle primitive has the wrong oriented branch, so the resulting ConditionB rejects basic HW cases such as a smooth on-curve simple pole.
